evidence.finding: ZEVOLT publishes multiple Garage Aubrée IRVE datasets (Loudéac, Taulé, Brest-Guipavas, Saint-Brieuc, Javené, Ergué-Gabéric, Vern-sur-Seiche), proving the historical 1-station/2-PDC footprint is no longer representative.

Current IRVE-derived records show some Garage Aubrée sites operated by MONTA while Vern-sur-Seiche still appears under GARAGE AUBREE (AUBREE GARAGES), so no single current CPO authority can be safely extrapolated across all sites.
No authoritative network-wide numeric direct tariff was recovered; per-site operator/tariff mapping is required.

decision: active->setAside; preserve Garage Aubrée historical authority as unresolved site/network family. Exact site->operator->tariff mapping required; do not inherit Monta or any roaming tariff across the family.
